replication.target_description: Relationship between webpage background complexity and attention to the commercial. Nonstudent adult replication sample. Supplied p.39 Table2 tests WEB EXPERIENCE, not webpage background complexity; it cannot supply the requested complexity test.

n.quote:

n.sample_role: Participants; reported recruitment/allocation count does not establish complete-case analytic n for this target.
n.exclusions: Target-specific exclusions and missing-data handling not established.

notes: PDF5–6 rendered and inspected. Table2 is a known predictor mismatch; its F and p are not extracted for complexity. Text reports only an omnibus complexity MANOVA, not a univariate target outcome test. Recruitment N95 is not certified as analytic n. No separate authors’ replication verdict for attention alone; the Appendix B umbrella statement does not establish whether the original nonsignificant attention result replicated. Appendix B PDF9 was also rendered: its sample-size row visually prints Study2 N92, contrasting with95 recruited in methods. This row is absent from canonical TXT; parent transcription/sample-role check required, and neither count is silently adopted as target-test analytic n.
